dictionary.node_type_rule: element + degree + sorted one-hop neighbor elements

radial_and_angle_basis.standardization: training-type pooled median and IQR/1.349, with standard-deviation fallback

dictionary.proper_candidates: all simple graph paths of length three
dictionary.out_of_plane_candidates: all unordered triples of neighbors around every degree-at-least-three center
dictionary.graph_distance_3_candidates: all atom pairs at molecular-graph distance three
dictionary.graph_distance_gt_3_candidates: all atom pairs at molecular-graph distance greater than three
